notes:
• A savings goal now spreads what is left over the months ahead, from next month up to the month of its target date. A goal due in April that you look at in November asks for one fifth each month, not one sixth. A goal due later this month asks for all of it now.

Already on an older version? Open Settings, then App updates, to install this one. Your data stays. A backup made on 0.3.6 or later cannot be restored on an older version.
